title: TRIBAL SCHOLARSHIP 2025-26
body_md:
Academic Session 2025-26 chhûng atân Tribal Scholarship dil theih a ni a. A hnuaia link-ah hian instructions a awm a; dil thei leh dil tum chuan kan lo ngaihven dawn nia. Students dil thei chuan mahni remchan dan anga lo bawhzui mai tur a ni.

Dil fel hnuah documents submit ngai te school-ah submit tur a ni a; documents submit lo chu application verify sak a rem dawn lo a ni.

**LINK**
[https://msb.mizoram.gov.in/post/tribal-scholarship-pre-post-matric-2025-2026](https://msb.mizoram.gov.in/post/tribal-scholarship-pre-post-matric-2025-2026)

Dil fel tawh hnua documents **submit **tûr leh submit-na tûr te:

**Renewal **tân chuan dilna **Application Printout **leh **School ID (Xerox copy) **submit tur a ni a.

**Fresh Applicants** tân chuan **Application Printout, Income Certificate (Original copy), ST Certificate (Xerox copy) leh School ID (Xerox copy) **te submit tur a ni e.
